data.name: Extra Heist Info
data.desc:
Do you want to just see codes and other info ? Download **Codes and Info** standalone [here](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59204).

**Please do not run both EHI and standalone versions at the same time.
Mods share the same codebase and game may crash.
Tracking elements in standalone versions is already included in EHI.**

**Minimum game version required: 1.0.0-158409 (Update 247)
Minimum SuperBLT version required: v1.5.0 (Lua) and [4.0.1-beta](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58342) (DLL)
Minimum EHI version to sync data to other EHI players: r427**
**!!! Failing to meet the minimum requirements will cause crashes in-game !!!**

Shows trackers for various heist related gameplay elements
- Waiting for a van/heli/boat
- Waiting for a C4
- Waiting for a thermite to finish
- Achievements*
- Achievements with progress (e.g.: "Another Way Out" achievement in Hell's Island)
- A chance for something to happen (e.g.: teargas, cooking chance)
- Mission XP Overview
- Buffs (skill or perk) and color them based on their action in-game
- Filter achievements tracked in EHI or for **The Secret** -> See progress filter in Achievements Page
- Damage hit markers or Floating health bars
- Hudlist
- etc...

See screenshots in the "Images" tab for more info and how it looks in-game.

EHI is using in-game panels and should be compatible with all HUD mods.
You can change x, y position in options to move it on the screen. The mod supports Ultra-Wide monitors.

**Accuracy**
Always accurate on host.
Clients should stay accurate within 1-3s range. It is recommended to install (on both host and client side players) [Slowmotion Manager](https://modworkshop.net/mod/18128) mod and remove all slowmotion effects that slows down time calculation.
Desync can also disallow some trackers to show up/update. There is nothing to prevent it.
If you drop-in to a heist, some trackers related to elements may not appear. This is because they are not synced when you drop-in. It can be improved, but it is unfixable.

**Trackers**
Some trackers are inaccurate and have orange color. These trackers can prematurely expire or expire late when an element (van, heli, ...) is interactable.

**Supported heists**
All vanilla heists are supported (Under the Hammer Heist (Update 248) is the latest vanilla heist). Custom heists are not supported due to I have to look into the map scripts and find elements that can be tracked. However, support for them may come at later date.

**Not supported mods**
If you have mods that modifies vanilla heists by either:
- adding more elements
- modifying existing elements (for example: shortening wait etc...)

EHI fails to recognize these changes and because of that, some trackers may not be accurate as they are in vanilla.
Example mods:
[Cook Faster](https://modworkshop.net/mod/16161)

**Compatible mods**
[Custom Name Color (HUD-compatible)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/22935) - your custom color shows up in trackers/waypoints/buffs that track peer related info (if enabled)
All HUD mods should be compatible
-> Tested WolfHUD, VanillaHUD Plus, CS HUD, MUI, Void UI and PocoHud3
[Any Day Any Heist](https://modworkshop.net/mod/43232)
[Hostages Extend Break Time](https://modworkshop.net/mod/50420)
[Classic Heisting](https://modworkshop.net/mod/33768)
-> XP Tracker is not visible - XP worked a bit differently in Update 24
-> Marshal tracker is not visible - Marshal groups did not exist in Update 24
-> Gage Mod Courier tracker is not visible - Gage packages were added **after** Update 24; in Update 26 to be precise

**Incompatible mods**
[Tweakdata Fixed](https://modworkshop.net/mod/21098) - EHI won't show up in-game (Press **0** twice to force refresh) or may randomly crash in Berserker buff when this mod installed.
[EHI Codes and Info Standalone](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59204) - Already included in this mod, game may crash if both mods are installed and active at the same time

**Languages**
- English
- Czech (Has to be manually selected in the mod options)
- French
- Thai (Recommended mod: [PAYDAY 2 THAI LANGUAGE](https://modworkshop.net/mod/17176)); **Looking for translator**
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Italian
- Japanese

**How to install**
Please see "Dependencies & Instructions" tab.

**Important:**
If you are crashing, always post a crashlog. I'm not a psychic nor I can read your mind and posting similar comments like "EHI is crashing my game, fix it asap" is not helping either.
Without crashlog I cannot help you.

**Feedback**
If the mod is crashing or you have an suggestion, please use the link to my Google Forms [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdE2ciCKNroP0o_-SEZWNGhoZNQu8RNRnj45yq0d4a8dwVaDg/viewform)

data.name: Rapunzel NIKKE Battle Announcer
data.desc:
Many believe that there exists an afterlife once we inevitably die. Now, what faith is right is a whole different can of worms, but it is widely believed that there exists an omnipotent being (God) and worshiping him will allow your soul to travel to the good afterlife. The Church and specifically, Christianity have been around for a long time. Over that time, a hierarchy was established to list the order of the most faithful to God. While a nun sits outside the hierarchy of the church, she does have a life of prayer and faith. One of those nuns happens to be Rapunzel. Her story is that she was a candidate to be the next Pope for V.T.C. But after an encounter with a certain red wolf, a new path opened up for her. One that has some "lustful" implications to put it that way. Despite this, she is sincere and is looking and praying for those that died on the surface some peace. She has She has 25 voicelines she can say, each having an equal chance of being played. Specifically, 

-----
When an enemy is killed (10 sec cooldown):
"No one will get hurt."
"I will look over everyone."
"May the Creator bless us."
"Eh?"
"My goodness."
"Whoa!"
"I'm ready."
"The garden of Shangri-La! No pain or despair!"
"Please guide us all to the light!"
"I'm always by your side."
"You want me to get on it? W-wait, that didn't come out right..."
"Everybody get ready."
"Oh. You really don't hold back."
"It would be nice if I was a bit more... well-rounded in certain areas."

-----
When the player takes damage (15 sec cooldown):
"No! The power of my prayers are declining."
"Sorry, please wait a minute."
"May all of us remain standing."
"Ow!"
"Errggh!"
"*Gasp!*"

-----
When a heist ends in success:
"We will also emerge victorious, so long as we never give up hope."
"All I want is to remember every moment spent with you. Is that too much to ask?"
"Believer, tell me, when can we finally submit to our desire to do whatever we wish?"
"Believer, you are virtuous. The sooner I tie you down, the better...! I mean... F-forget I said anything!"

-----
When a heist ends in failure:
"I may have fallen... but so long as all of you are safe..."

-----
In game demo: ![](https://youtu.be/4UjNvrk1djQ)

Fail line (short): ![](https://youtu.be/OC0V3AVKS00)

data.name: Noah NIKKE Battle Announcer
data.desc:
"Your weakness is simply one of your many charms. This way, the only way I'll lose is if I let you win on purpose! Hehehe." - Noah. If you give a child too much power, there's a high chance that they may end up spoiled or worse, an absolute troll. If ragebaiting ain't your style, then Noah isn't for you. The catalyst that allows Noah so much room to talk and back it up are her shields. They hold up to any kind fire you throw at them whether it's a .50 cal bullet from a machine gun, a missile from a rocket launcher, or even a flamethrower. Nothing is getting past those shields. It's not all defense though, as the shields are built with cannons for a counter attack or simply let one of the other members of Inherit clean up after you. No wonder Noah acts so childish, she has everyone else do the dirty work around her. She has 17 voicelines she can say, each having an equal chance of being played. Specifically, 

-----
When an enemy is killed (10 sec cooldown):
"Time to crush those weaklings. Hehehe."
"Like shooting fish in a barrel."
"You can't even leave a scratch on my shield."
"Weaklings."
"So easy."
"Anyone?"
"Imposter, now!"
"Those guys are dead meat."
"I am invincible! Hehehehe."
"Girls, teach them a lesson!"
"Let's get started!"
"Hehehehe."

-----
When a heist ends in success:
"If only a REAL commander could see this."
"Hypocrite, very well, you may caress my hair. Not everyone can earn this privilege."
"I normally don't allow Imposters to follow me, but I'll make an exception for you. Just keep it a secret, all right?"
"Why are you so eager to have a closer relationship with me? Well, either way, I won't say no to it."

-----
When a heist ends in failure:
"No, impossible!"

-----

data.name: Seamless Input Switch
data.desc:
Seamless Input Switch lets the local player move freely between keyboard/mouse and gamepad while PAYDAY2 is running, in both offline and online heists without restarting your game. Hotswap.

**The site lost 48 hours of data. I’ve fixed many bugs, and the mod is now much more stable and includes several new features. Check the changelog if you’re interested in what’s new!**

# Seamless Input Switch - PAYDAY2 Mod (64-bit)

> [!NOTE]
> Seamless Input Switch is an unofficial, fan-made project created by Lukituki6. Neither Lukituki6 nor this project is affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or associated with STARBREEZE Studios, Sidetrack Games, Microsoft/Xbox, Sony Interactive Entertainment/PlayStation, Valve/Steam, or any of their subsidiaries. All trademarks, product names, and company names belong to their respective owners.   

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

Version: **1.1.1**  
Author: **Lukituki6**

Seamless Input Switch lets the local player move freely between keyboard/mouse and gamepad while PAYDAY 2 is running, in both offline and online heists.

~~This release has no automatic updater. Installation and future updates are manual.~~ **done**

I only own a DualSense Edge, so I haven’t been able to test other controllers. **They should work too, though (hopefully)**.

**AI-Assisted**

**The mod is pure Lua. It contains no native DLL, hard-coded memory address, or old 32-bit data structure.**

## Requirements

* PAYDAY2 **Diesel 3.0 / 64-bit**;
* a working **64-bit SuperBLT** installation;
* a gamepad connected and detected **before launching the game**;
* BeardLib is not required.

For DualSense Edge, Steam Input is recommended. PAYDAY 2 will normally receive it as an XInput (`xb1`) controller. Version 1.0.0 keeps the public UI type in PC mode, but displayed prompts can independently use PC labels, A/B/X/Y glyphs, or Cross/Triangle/Square/Circle text labels. Aim assist is also controlled independently of those labels.

## Installation

1. Close PAYDAY 2.
2. Extract the archive into `PAYDAY 2/mods`.
3. Confirm that the manifest is located at:
`PAYDAY 2/mods/Seamless Input Switch/mod.txt`.
4. Connect the gamepad, launch the game, and press a keyboard key or gamepad button at the title screen.

Settings are available under `Options > Mod Options > Seamless Input Switch`.

The English interface is loaded by default. If PAYDAY2 is running in Polish, the mod automatically overlays the Polish localization.

## Input modes

* **Automatic** - keyboard, mouse, and gamepad are connected to one game-owned virtual controller; the most recently used device selects the appropriate camera look routine.
* **Force keyboard/mouse semantics** - locks camera/detection behavior to PC without destroying the physical gamepad route.
* **Force gamepad semantics** - locks camera/detection behavior to gamepad and falls back to PC semantics if the pad disconnects.

The gamepad switch threshold can be increased if stick drift changes the active device unexpectedly. Its default value is `0.18`. A separate axis-change threshold (`0.10`) controls how much an already displaced stick must change before it counts as new activity.

## Controller vibration

PAYDAY 2 controller vibration is restored by routing rumble effects to the physical gamepad. It can be enabled or disabled under `Options > Mod Options > Seamless Input Switch` and is enabled by default.

## Displayed control prompts

* **PC / current keyboard bindings** - the existing keyboard and mouse labels;
* **A/B/X/Y** - glyphs from PAYDAY 2's built-in PC font, resolved from the live gamepad layout and the mod's custom bindings;
* **CIRCLE, SQUARE, CROSS, TRIANGLE (text)** - short safe labels such as `[R1]`, `[L2]`, `[X]`, `[O]`, `[SQ]`, and `[TRI]`.

This setting is fixed and never changes `is pc controller()`, the wrapper type, or the controller id. It therefore cannot reactivate the native `MenuSceneGui` path that caused the earlier access violation game crash. Full graphical **CIRCLE, SQUARE, CROSS, TRIANGLE (text)** glyphs are not present in the stock PC button font and would require binary font-asset replacement, so this safe build uses text labels.

## Gamepad camera settings

* **Gamepad look sensitivity** - multiplies manual right-stick turn speed from `0.50–4.00`; the `2.00` default is twice the base-game speed.
* **Gamepad ADS sensitivity** - an additional multiplier used only while aiming down sights, from `0.50–2.00`; the `1.00` default keeps the same proportion.
* **Right-stick deadzone** - ignores small stick movement from `0.00–0.30`; the `0.05` default reduces drift without a large precision loss.
* **Invert gamepad vertical look** - off by default, so pushing up looks up. Enable it for inverted flight-style control.
* **Outer deadzone** for both sticks - reaches full input before the physical edge; `0.00` preserves vanilla behavior.
* **Response curve** for both sticks - `1.00` keeps the linear post-deadzone response, values below `1.00` react faster near center, and values above `1.00` provide finer small corrections.
* **Left-stick inner deadzone** - the `0.10` default matches PAYDAY 2's built-in movement cutoff; increase it only to suppress drift.

Advanced values are under `Advanced stick tuning`. They apply only while gamepad semantics are active and do not modify mouse sensitivity or the saved stock controller profile.

## Aim-assist tuning

The `Always-on aim assist` master switch remains enabled by default. Its submenu can independently:

* enable or disable continuous sticky aim;
* scale sticky correction speed from `0.25` to `2.00`;
* enable or disable attraction when entering ADS;
* scale ADS attraction speed from `0.25` to `2.00`.

`1.00` matches vanilla correction speed.

## Gamepad layout and custom bindings

With `Enable custom gameplay bindings` off, the mod copies PAYDAY 2's live controller profile. The vanilla `xb1`/Steam Input defaults are:

|Action|Xbox / DualSense through Steam Input|
|-|-|
|Fire / ADS|RT / R2 - LT / L2|
|Interact and shout|RB / R1|
|Deployable|LB / L1 - hold to deploy, tap to switch the primary/secondary item|
|Jump / crouch / reload / switch weapon|A / Cross - B / Circle - X / Square - Y / Triangle|
|Sprint / melee|L3 / R3|
|Grenade / weapon gadget or bipod / fire mode|D-pad left / down / right|

Open `Options > Mod Options > Seamless Input Switch > Gamepad bindings` to enable a custom profile and remap thirteen gameplay actions. Changes apply after leaving the menu. `Restore vanilla bindings` disables the custom profile and restores the layout above. Duplicate assignments are allowed and deliberately trigger every action assigned to that button. Menu navigation, Start, and Back remain fixed to prevent an accidental menu lockout.

The editable profile targets `xb1`, including DualSense controllers translated by Steam Input. Other native gamepad types safely keep their live vanilla layout.

## Online and offline compatibility

The mod operates entirely on the local player's input objects. It does not add network messages, alter heist synchronization, or modify input for other peers. The same local player controller is used while:

* playing an offline heist;
* hosting a private or public online session;
* joining another host as a client;
* moving through lobby, briefing, gameplay, and results screens.

Other players and the host do not need the mod installed. This follows directly from the local-only implementation.



## Known limitations

* Connecting a completely new gamepad after the game has launched is not guaranteed. Connect it before startup.
* One preferred gamepad is supported. Multiple simultaneous controllers are untested.
* UI in Menu/Lobby after changing from PC to other, still uses PC/keyboard layout.

## Diagnostics and safe removal

If one device becomes unavailable, first select a forced PC or gamepad mode under Mod Options. If the menu cannot be reached, close the game and delete:

`PAYDAY 2/mods/saves/seamless-input-switch.json`

To disable the mod completely, move the `Seamless Input Switch` folder outside `PAYDAY 2/mods`.

For a useful bug report, keep:

* the latest `PAYDAY 2/mods/logs/log.txt`;
* `crash.txt`, if one was produced;
* the screen or heist where the issue occurred;
* whether you were offline, host, or client;
* whether Steam Input was enabled and which button icon family appeared;
* the last input sequence, for example `mouse → right stick → Escape`.

data.name: HK437 & HK433 (2025)
data.desc:
If I had a nickel for every time HK tried to sell a cheaper alternative to one of their popular designs only for the alternative to be ignored for the more expensive design, I'd have two nickels. Which isn't a lot, but it's weird it's happened twice.
---

The HK437 is unlocked at level 40 and will appear to others as the AK5. The 437 is mostly a stat clone-ish of the vanilla M16/AMR16 but with the caveat of being semi auto only. 
There is also a companion HK433, unlocked at level 25 and also appearing to others as the AK5. The 433 takes after the BF6 depiction and has a stat block similar to the F2000/Union 556 as a high fire rate low damage rifle.  

The two guns can share some parts thanks to the model creator's realism accurate proportions.
The A-Tec A-Flow A2 suppressors becomes available for all weapons because I don't see the point in putting it in Capitalism Muzzles.

Yes, this mod has been a few years in the making, such is the life of my personal Stoner derivatives.

---

**Known Issues:**

* if you use the fnuxray ar15 animations, you are very likely to misalign the optic zero on the 437/433. 
* No, I am not adding Quadstacked magazines since the original M8A1 standard animation only was designed around 30 round mags. Use drum mags or magazines with baseplates at your own peril.
* yes i think the vertical and angled grips look stupid with how I had to place them, but scoomt asked me very nicely to include them


---

**Probable Future Asked Questions**

Q: Where 3rd position on 437?
A: G39s from HK seem to only have semi auto, so I represented that by locking the 437 into semi. You can add it back in by editing the HK437's xml to make `CAN_TOGGLE_FIREMODE="true"` (it is false by default to lock the weapon into semi).

Q: Can we get the HKey handguard?
A: I actually tried to fit the MW2019 handguard on, but the lack of the toprail on the MW2019 handguards makes it a play very poorly with the gadget positions

Q: More AR15 stocks? 
A: No because I got tired of having to re-export the stock models every time I made an adjustment to AR15 stocks positions. Also I don't think I'm alone with being displeased with how the 2025 437 lost its scar-oid look. So the E1 stock with Riser is all you get.

Q: wait I thought this had a paddle magazine release?
A: The 433 actually has two lowers: one with the G36 style paddle mag near the trigger guard and bolt release near the trigger guard. The other one uses 416/AR style controls with a push button mag release and push down bolt release where most users expect the AR15 ping pong paddle.

Since the M8A1 animation assumed push button animations, I went with the push button 433 lower. Also worth noting the model author (and HK/the KSK?) seems to be moving forwards with the push button lower as their preferred choice.

Q: What do you mean by "2025"?
A: Every time I look at Milpol, Shot Show, or browse HKPro, HK seems to be changing something about the HK433 platform, such as the 2026 HK437 sporting a conical shroud on its handguard to cover the suppressor. Why they bother is beyond me since everyone's just going to ask for the Hk416 anyways.

data.name: Hawks's (awfully) Rebalanced
data.desc:
**{#007bff}(Jesus Christ, can you even imagine, how poorly little part of the huge weaponary can actually be seen used in any public lobby???)**
Well, I guess I'ma here to fix this ~~shi~~stuff! Introducing - Hawks's ~~awfully~~ Rebalanced!
~~Basically buffed those old and outdated weapons, without much change to the new one's.~~
That's what I thought it's gonna be, until... There became more and more fucntions and balances, its rather a total overhaul to the game, in my style.


-----
**EVERYTHING**, literally **EVERYTHING**, now have a swich. You can disable **{#007bff}(EVERY SINGLE FUNCTION)** that you don't like, and only use those you really wanted. **{#ffffff}(You don't like your favourite weapon being nerfed?) {#007bff}(Fine, turn it) {#FF0000}(off){#007bff}(.) {#ffffff}(You find some of the functions redicilous?) {#007bff}(Never mind!) {#FF0000}(Off){#007bff}( it goes!)** **{#ffffff}(You wanna use some other rebalance with this?)** **{#007bff}(Disable whatever you want) to make them compatitable.** Check **Mod Options**!
Most of this mod uses Lua. Clearer player smoke also uses SuperBLT Wren scripts, and Soft White includes a color-grading texture. It can be **safely added** and **removed** anytime from your game.
This mod will neither break your savefile, nor mark you as a cheater. 
The Shotguns Part are mainly from respectable content creater Sae's excellent mod {#007bff}(**[Sae's Shotgun Overhaul](https://modworkshop.net/mod/42087)**), I left the link here. Please do check out!
Supported Languages: 
**English**
**Simplified Chinese**

-----
**Here Comes the Changes**

{#007bff}(**Special Functions**)
!!!
**{#007bff}(Import and Export Skill trees)**
Files will be Exported into Json files, inside the mod's folder. Check Mod Options!
This is for people who want to try each others' set-ups, and this saves some effort!
!!!

{#007bff}(**Skills**)
!!!
**Desperado** (Pistol Skills) **Ace**: 
You still get the {#007bff}(50%) Pistol reload speed buff.
But additionally, **each successful shot** with a **Revolver** grants one stack for {#007bff}(10) seconds. Each stack additionally **increases Revolver reload speed** by {#007bff}(10%), up to {#007bff}(5) stacks. All stacks are **cleared** after reloading. This only works on **Revolvers**.
Fixed a recursive reload-speed hook that could cause stack-overflow crashes with other mods.

**Berserker**:
Added a new throwable called {#007bff}(**"Cocktail Ampule"**). Enabling it will reduce your health to {#007bff}(10%), but also making you extremely weak for a short period. Berserker lives matter, but not to break balance.

**Metal Fatigue** **Ace** (Originally **Shock and Awe**):
Now, you can shoot though shields, when the original shock is triggered, for only **{#007bff}(1)** bullet. This won't make a big difference, but to make head-shotting shields rather possible.

**Close By (Shotgun Skill)**:
**Slam Fire**: When using a **Pump Shotgun**, holding mouse1 will make you **Slam Fire** the weapon, which is to shoot as fast as the weapon can. This either won't make a big difference, just a QoL change.

**I HATE JOKERS**
Now you won't need to capture SWATs and turn them into your pieces. The skill takes place without jokers, but you will receive a weaker buff. Off by default.
!!!

{#007bff}(**Perk Decks**)

**Sicario**

!!!
Now, the **Smoke Screen** Lasts {#007bff}(15) seconds instead of {#007bff}(10).
Now, enemies who try to shoot though the **Smoke Screen** will receive the same accuracy debuff. This means that you don't have to be inside the smoke, to be protected by the smoke.
Now, you can use the **Police**'s **Smoke Screen** as well, receiving the **dodge buff**. However, shoot though protection will not work on **Police**'s **Smoke Screen**.

**Smoke reserves and recharge**: Carry up to {#007bff}(2) smoke bombs; {#007bff}(90) seconds to recharge each, reduced by {#007bff}(2) seconds per kill. Charges recharge one at a time. A separate option.

**Clearer player smoke**: Player smoke opacity reduced by {#007bff}(50%) locally, including teammates' smoke. Police smoke stays unchanged. A separate option.
!!!

To be updated...

{#007bff}(**Game Mechanics**)
!!!
**"Perfect Recoil Control"**:
Now, any weapon with {#ff00ff}(100) recoil stats, will have **no spray pattern** but randomly slightly kicks in four directions.

**Disarm**
Now, you can literally equip nothing for main or secondary, or both weapon slots. Each unequipped weapon will count as {#007bff}(35) Concealment.

**Use your deploybles!!!**
When carrying loot on your back, facing the ground and hold G will first count as using deploybles. No more stuck holding G for nothing. Another QoL change.

**Weld your melee**:
Press E to shift to melee weapon and won't automatically swich back, as if it's a proper weapon instead of a one-click-use stuff. Disabled by default.

**Single Fire Akimbo Pistols**:
Shoot only one gun at a time. Disabled as default.

**Inspect Menu**
Disable annoying weapon wobbling up and down when inspecting or customizing your weapons. QoL change.

**Name Length Unlimited**
Now you can rename your weapons and set-ups, using as many letters you want.

**No Quotes**
Removed custom weapon names being quoted. Like, why?

**Soft White**:
Added a color-grading option in the game's video settings to soften harsh highlights. Select another grading to turn it off.
!!!
**{#007bff}(Weapon Stats)**

Weapon adjustments below follow the current Lua files, when their switches are enabled. Pickup ranges are before skills; Accuracy/Stability are displayed points. Reload stat indices are not seconds. Prices and unlock levels are excluded.

Broken features / scripts have also been fixed and the heist should feel much nicer to play now. Visual oversights have also been tended to, like being able to see cops spawn due to poor spawn placement.

I plan on updating this map as I make more fixes to it!

I hope you'll enjoy this rework, feel free to leave feedback! :3
